text:
Nora Feldman: Quick usability note from the prototyping session— the batch import success toast links to 'View vectors' but when you follow it the table selection state is lost. users expected the rows they just uploaded to be highlighted.
Ravi Kapoor: repro steps? I thought we kept a query param with uploaded_ids.
Nora Feldman: steps: Upload CSV -> toast appears "Upload complete — 12 vectors" -> click "View vectors" -> opens Vectors list but no filter or selection.
Ivy Chen: ux expectation is reasonable. Two approaches: 1) deep-link with ?uploaded_ids=... + highlight rows and announce via aria-live, or 2) redirect into a temporary 'import preview' state that shows the uploaded bundle with a persistent header.
A11y QA: for screen readers the deep-link approach needs an aria-live announcement once the table renders: "12 uploaded vectors shown; 12 selected." otherwise SR users won't know the selection happened. Make sure focus lands on the counter or toolbar rather than the table body.
Ravi Kapoor: technical: deep-linking with 12 ids will inflate the URL but ok for short lists. For >200 rows we should store an import_token and link with token=abc123. token approach avoids long URLs.
Nora Feldman: microcopy: change toast link from "View vectors" to "View uploaded vectors" to set expectation. Also update toast to include size: "Upload complete — 12 vectors (CSV)".
Ivy Chen: design trade: if we deep-link to Vectors page with selections, add a subtle banner: "Showing recent upload: 12 vectors" with CTA "Clear selection". Banner should be dismissible and keyboard-focusable.
Samir Patel: export corner-case: when user immediately hits Export on that view, we should default to "Export selected" (the uploaded set) rather than "Export all in table". Confirm behaviour in spec.
A11y QA: banner semantics: role="region" + aria-label="Recent upload". When banner appears, do NOT auto-shift focus; instead add an aria-live message: "12 vectors highlighted from your recent upload". Users don't want focus stolen.
Ravi Kapoor: backend: implement token flow: upload returns token_id; Vectors page accepts token_id param; server expands token to ids and returns a lightweight hint payload: {"count":12, "sample_ids":[...], "created_at":"..."} — UI can then highlight. We'll make token TTL short (1 hour).
Nora Feldman: export naming: when exporting the uploaded selection use filename pattern: "upload-<uploader>-<date>-selected.csv" rather than generic 'vectors-...'. helps traceability.
Ivy Chen: tooltip copy: for the 'Select all' checkbox when in upload view, tooltip should read "Select all 12 uploaded vectors". Avoid ambiguous "Select all".
A11y QA: keyboard flow: after clicking toast -> Vectors view, tab order should be: 1) banner dismiss, 2) selection counter (aria-live region), 3) table header -> selected rows. ensure screen reader reads the banner and then the aria-live counter.
Samir Patel: edge-case: if user navigates away and comes back via history, token may have expired. show a fallback state: banner "Recent upload expired; show results" with CTA to re-run import preview.
DesignBot: Created issue #5344: "Upload deep-linking: selection persistence, token flow, aria-live banner, export filename" and assigned to Ravi Kapoor. :white_check_mark:
A11y QA: I'll attach a short test plan to #5344: toast link behaviour, aria-live messages, focus retention, large-upload token fallback.
Nora Feldman: I'll mock banner + table highlight states (focused banner, collapsed banner, and abandoned token fallback) and upload them to the issue by tomorrow. Thanks!
